trajectory.summary: Parsed and disassembled the AVR firmware. Rounds 1-3 spent substantial time on an unchecked STK500-style page-write/16-bit-wrap hypothesis and a modeled indirect-call stream that could not be emulated. In round 4, Luna pivoted to application GPIO output: traced pin-13 writes and delays, extracted an alternating sampled level sequence, decoded an ASCII payload, and submitted the embedded key. The controller independently verified the exact candidate.
